title: Bootstrap fails with IncompleteRead — transient network disruption on aarch64 runners
error_summary: HTTP connection broken mid-transfer (IncompleteRead) during package resolution on aarch64 runners, causing fatal bootstrap failure
suggested_resolution_summary: Retry the failed jobs; no code change required — this is a transient network issue
confidence_justification: The error message directly identifies the cause (IncompleteRead during HTTP transfer). The two jobs failed at different progress points (77% vs 84%) and different byte counts (228 KB vs 1.1 MB), confirming non-determinism. Other aarch64 bootstrap jobs for smaller collections succeeded in the same pipeline run, consistent with a transient issue that disproportionately affects longer-running bootstraps.
